models.notes: Cheap, fast volume player, and the one model the blind launch flags have actually been exercised against on this machine (claude 2.1.251). Settings are empty on purpose: with no settings.reasoning_effort the runner appends no --effort flag and the CLI's own default applies, so this block still claims nothing it does not enforce. Populate reasoning_effort only when that exact launch dial should be pinned (run.sh maps it to `--effort`).

Fast volume player. Confirm availability against your subscription. Must stay a full model name — `--model` also accepts aliases like 'fable', and an alias resolves to different weights over time, so a session recorded under one stops meaning what its record says.

The default claude_code blind player (no --model needed). settings.reasoning_effort is enforced at launch: run.sh appends `--effort medium` to the registry argv, and claude 2.1.251 accepts --effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Verified live: `claude --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort medium --print` answers on this subscription.
Calibration instrument: its job is not to find more bugs than the volume cohort but to say whether that cohort's silence means anything.
